Cảm ơn em đã đến và làm cho cuộc sống của anh trở nên dịu dàng và đầy màu sắc hơn...

Em là đóa hoa đẹp nhất trong vườn hoa cuộc đời anh, là cô gái anh thương nhất.

Mỗi khoảnh khắc bên em đều là món quà quý giá.

        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Be+Vietnam+Pro:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Dancing+Script:wght@600;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,600;0,700;1,600;1,700&display=swap');
        *{box-sizing:border-box}
        html,body{margin:0;padding:0}
        .gift-root{
          min-height:100vh;
          min-height:100dvh;
          width:100%;
          font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro", system-ui, sans-serif;
          overflow-x:clip;
          position:relative;
          isolation:isolate;
        }
        button{font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif; cursor:pointer}

        /* Stage 1 */
        .stage1{
          min-height:100vh;
          min-height:100dvh;
          display:flex;
          flex-direction:column;
          align-items:center;
          justify-content:center;
          padding:28px 18px;
          padding-top:calc(28px + var(--safe-area-inset-top,0px));
          background:
            radial-gradient(120% 90% at 20% 10%, #ffdee8 0%, transparent 55%),
            radial-gradient(110% 80% at 85% 15%, #ffe4b8 0%, transparent 50%),
            radial-gradient(90% 70% at 50% 90%, #ffc9d6 0%, #fffaf6 55%),
            linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf6 0%,#fff0f0 100%);
          position:relative;
        }
        .envelope-scene{
          width:100%;
          max-width:420px;
          display:flex;
          flex-direction:column;
          align-items:center;
          gap:28px;
          position:relative;
        }
        .envelope{
          width:380px;
          max-width:92vw;
          height:260px;
          position:relative;
          transform-style:preserve-3d;
          filter: drop-shadow(0 18px 40px rgba(201,24,74,0.18));
        }
        .envelope-body{
          position:absolute;
          inset:0;
          top:46%;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fffbf6 0%,#fff1e6 100%);
          border-radius:0 0 18px 18px;
          border:1.2px solid rgba(198,168,110,0.28);
          border-top:none;
          z-index:2;
          overflow:hidden;
        }
        .envelope-body::before{
          content:"";
          position:absolute;
          left:0; right:0; top:0;
          height:1px;
          background:rgba(198,168,110,0.2);
        }
        .envelope-flap{
          position:absolute;
          left:0; right:0; top:0;
          height:52%;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fff6ee 0%,#ffdfd0 100%);
          clip-path: polygon(0 0,50% 88%,100% 0,100% 0,0 0);
          transform-origin: top center;
          transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1);
          z-index:4;
          border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;
          border:1.2px solid rgba(198,168,110,0.28);
          border-bottom:none;
        }
        .envelope-flap.open{
          transform: rotateX(-172deg);
        }
        .envelope-letter{
          position:absolute;
          left:5%;
          width:90%;
          height:88%;
          top:28%;
          background:#fffdf8;
          border-radius:10px;
          border:1px solid rgba(198,168,110,0.3);
          box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
          z-index:3;
          display:flex;
          align-items:center;
          justify-content:center;
          transition: transform 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) 0.15s;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
        .envelope-letter.up{
          transform: translateY(-52%);
        }
        .letter-lines{
          width:72%;
          height:62%;
          background:
            linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0) 0 18px, rgba(201,24,74,0.12) 18px 19px, transparent 19px 100%);
          background-size:100% 22px;
          opacity:0.7;
        }
        .wax-seal{
          position:absolute;
          left:50%;
          top:48%;
          transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
          width:62px; height:62px;
          background: radial-gradient(80% 80% at 35% 30%, #ff4d6d 0%, #d90429 58%, #9b0a1f 100%);
          border-radius:50%;
          z-index:6;
          display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
          box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(217,4,41,0.45), inset 0 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
          border:2px solid #ffcfd6;
          transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.4s;
        }
        .wax-seal.hide{
          opacity:0;
          transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0.2);
          pointer-events:none;
        }
        .wax-seal span{font-size:28px; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.3));}
        .badge-date{
          display:inline-flex;
          padding:6px 16px;
          border-radius:100px;
          background:#fff;
          border:1px solid rgba(201,24,74,0.12);
          font-size:11px;
          letter-spacing:0.18em;
          color:#c9184a;
          font-weight:600;
          box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(201,24,74,0.08);
        }
        .title-main{
          font-family:"Playfair Display", serif;
          font-weight:700;
          font-size:40px;
          line-height:1.08;
          color:#5a1a2a;
          text-align:center;
          margin:18px 0 10px;
        }
        .title-main i{
          font-style:italic;
          color:#c9184a;
          font-weight:700;
        }
        .sub-dancing{
          font-family:"Dancing Script", cursive;
          font-size:19px;
          color:#b06a7a;
        }
        .btn-primary{
          background: linear-gradient(135deg,#ff4d6d 0%,#c9184a 100%);
          color:white;
          border:none;
          padding:14px 30px;
          border-radius:100px;
          font-weight:600;
          font-size:15px;
          letter-spacing:0.01em;
          box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(201,24,74,0.28), 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35) inset;
          transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, filter 0.2s;
        }
        .btn-primary:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); filter:brightness(1.06)}
        .btn-primary:active{ transform: scale(0.98)}
        .fly-heart{
          position:absolute;
          font-size:18px;
          pointer-events:none;
          animation: flyHeart var(--d) ease-out forwards;
          left:var(--x);
          top:var(--y);
        }
        @keyframes flyHeart{
          0%{ transform: translate(0,0) scale(0.6) rotate(0deg); opacity:0}
          10%{ opacity:1}
          100%{ transform: translate(var(--tx), var(--ty)) scale(1.4) rotate(18deg); opacity:0}
        }

        /* Stage 2 */
        .stage2{
          min-height:100vh;
          min-height:100dvh;
          display:flex;
          align-items:center;
          justify-content:center;
          padding:30px 18px;
          padding-top:calc(30px + var(--safe-area-inset-top,0px));
          background:
            radial-gradient(70% 60% at 20% 20%, #ffdde4 0%, transparent 60%),
            radial-gradient(70% 60% at 90% 10%, #ffe6c2 0%, transparent 55%),
            linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf6 0%,#fff1f3 100%);
          animation: fadeIn 0.7s ease;
        }
        .letter-card{
          width:100%;
          max-width:560px;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdf8 0%,#fff6eb 100%);
          border:1.5px solid rgba(198,168,110,0.35);
          border-radius:22px;
          box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(90,26,42,0.12), 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9) inset;
          padding:32px 30px 28px;
          position:relative;
        }
        .letter-card::before{
          content:"";
          position:absolute;
          inset:10px;
          border:1.2px dashed rgba(198,168,110,0.35);
          border-radius:14px;
          pointer-events:none;
        }
        .corner-ornament{
          position:absolute;
          font-size:22px;
          opacity:0.35;
        }
        .corner-ornament.tl{left:18px; top:14px}
        .corner-ornament.tr{right:18px; top:14px; transform:scaleX(-1)}
        .corner-ornament.bl{left:18px; bottom:14px; transform:scaleY(-1)}
        .corner-ornament.br{right:18px; bottom:14px; transform:scale(-1)}
        .badge-note{
          display:inline-flex;
          margin:0 auto 18px;
          background:#fff3e0;
          color:#a67c52;
          font-size:11px;
          font-weight:700;
          letter-spacing:0.16em;
          padding:7px 14px;
          border-radius:100px;
        }
        .typed-wrap{
          font-family:"Be Vietnam Pro",sans-serif;
          font-size:15.5px;
          line-height:1.9;
          color:#5a1a2a;
          white-space:pre-wrap;
          min-height:220px;
          position:relative;
          z-index:1;
        }
        .cursor{
          display:inline-block;
          width:2px; height:1.15em;
          background:#c9184a;
          margin-left:2px;
          vertical-align:-2px;
          animation: blink 0.9s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes blink{0%,50%{opacity:1}51%,100%{opacity:0}}
        @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(12px)} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)}}

        /* Stage 3 */
        .stage3{
          min-height:100vh;
          min-height:100dvh;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fff0f5 0%,#ffd1dc 45%,#ffccd5 100%);
          padding:18px 16px 40px;
          padding-top:calc(18px + var(--safe-area-inset-top,0px));
          position:relative;
          overflow:clip;
          display:flex;
          flex-direction:column;
          align-items:center;
        }
        .mesh-blobs{
          position:absolute;
          inset:0;
          pointer-events:none;
          overflow:hidden;
        }
        .blob{
          position:absolute;
          border-radius:50%;
          filter: blur(48px);
          opacity:0.55;
        }
        .blob1{ width:360px; height:360px; background:#ff8fab; left:-80px; top:6%; animation: drift 12s ease-in-out infinite}
        .blob2{ width:420px; height:420px; background:#ffb3c6; right:-90px; top:28%; animation: drift 14s ease-in-out infinite reverse}
        .blob3{ width:300px; height:300px; background:#ffc8dd; left:30%; bottom:5%; animation: drift 11s ease-in-out infinite}
        @keyframes drift{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)} 50%{transform:translate(18px,-22px) scale(1.08)}}

        .bokeh{
          position:absolute;
          inset:0;
          pointer-events:none;
        }
        .bokeh-dot{
          position:absolute;
          width:6px; height:6px;
          border-radius:50%;
          background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
          box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
          animation: twinkle var(--dur) ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:0.15; transform:scale(0.6)} 50%{opacity:0.9; transform:scale(1.3)}}

        .petal{
          position:absolute;
          top:-20px;
          font-size:18px;
          pointer-events:none;
          animation: fall linear forwards;
        }
        @keyframes fall{
          0%{ transform: translate3d(var(--x),0,0) rotate(0deg); opacity:0}
          10%{opacity:0.9}
          90%{opacity:0.9}
          100%{ transform: translate3d(calc(var(--x) + var(--drift)), 108vh, 0) rotate(720deg); opacity:0}
        }
        .gold-dust{
          position:absolute;
          width:3px; height:3px;
          background: radial-gradient(circle,#ffd166 0%,#ffb703 100%);
          border-radius:50%;
          pointer-events:none;
          animation: goldFloat var(--dur) ease-in-out infinite;
          box-shadow:0 0 6px #ffd166;
        }
        @keyframes goldFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-18px)}}

        .header-stage3{
          text-align:center;
          margin:14px 0 8px;
          position:relative;
          z-index:2;
        }
        .header-stage3 h2{
          font-family:"Playfair Display", serif;
          font-size:26px;
          font-weight:700;
          color:#5a1a2a;
          margin:0 0 6px;
          line-height:1.2;
        }
        .header-stage3 p{
          font-family:"Dancing Script", cursive;
          font-size:19px;
          color:#c9184a;
          margin:0;
        }
        .bouquet-scene{
          width:100%;
          max-width:520px;
          aspect-ratio:0.86;
          perspective:1200px;
          position:relative;
          z-index:2;
          margin-top:6px;
          display:flex;
          align-items:flex-start;
          justify-content:center;
        }
        .bouquet-wrap{
          width:100%;
          height:100%;
          position:relative;
          display:flex;
          align-items:flex-start;
          justify-content:center;
          transform-style:preserve-3d;
        }
        .bouquet-img-box{
          position:relative;
          width:100%;
          max-height:86vh;
          display:flex;
          justify-content:center;
          cursor:pointer;
          animation: bouquetPop 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) both, breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite 1.2s;
          transform-origin: center bottom;
        }
        .bouquet-img-box.surpriseSpin{
          animation: surpriseSpin 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) both;
        }
        @keyframes bouquetPop{
          0%{ transform: scale(0.2) translateY(120px) rotate(-8deg); opacity:0}
          60%{ transform: scale(1.08) translateY(-8px) rotate(2deg); opacity:1}
          100%{ transform: scale(1) translateY(0) rotate(0deg); opacity:1}
        }
        @keyframes breathe{
          0%,100%{ transform: scale(1) translateY(0)}
          50%{ transform: scale(1.02) translateY(-6px)}
        }
        @keyframes surpriseSpin{
          0%{ transform: scale(1) rotateY(0)}
          50%{ transform: scale(1.12) rotateY(180deg)}
          100%{ transform: scale(1.06) rotateY(360deg)}
        }
        .bouquet-img-box img{
          max-width:100%;
          max-height:86vh;
          width:auto;
          height:auto;
          object-fit:contain;
          filter: drop-shadow(0 28px 40px rgba(90,26,42,0.28)) drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(201,24,74,0.18));
          user-select:none;
          -webkit-user-drag:none;
        }
        .sweep{
          position:absolute;
          inset:0;
          background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 35%, rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 50%, transparent 65%);
          mix-blend-mode: overlay;
          transform: translateX(-120%);
          animation: sweep 3.8s ease-in-out infinite 1.5s;
          pointer-events:none;
        }
        @keyframes sweep{
          0%{ transform: translateX(-120%) skewX(-12deg)}
          55%{ transform: translateX(120%) skewX(-12deg)}
          100%{ transform: translateX(120%) skewX(-12deg)}
        }
        .reflection{
          position:absolute;
          left:0; right:0; bottom:-18%;
          height:36%;
          transform: scaleY(-1);
          opacity:0.18;
          filter: blur(2px);
          mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 0%, transparent 85%);
          pointer-events:none;
        }
        .pedestal{
          position:absolute;
          bottom:2%;
          left:50%;
          transform:translateX(-50%);
          width:62%;
          height:26px;
          background: radial-gradient(60% 100% at 50% 0%, rgba(90,26,42,0.22) 0%, transparent 70%);
          filter: blur(8px);
          pointer-events:none;
        }
        .tap-hint{
          position:relative;
          z-index:2;
          margin-top:10px;
          font-family:"Dancing Script",cursive;
          font-size:16px;
          color:#b05a6e;
          background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
          border:1px solid rgba(201,24,74,0.12);
          padding:8px 18px;
          border-radius:100px;
          backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
          animation: pulseHint 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
          box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(201,24,74,0.12);
        }
        @keyframes pulseHint{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)} 50%{transform:scale(1.05)}}

        .burst{
          position:absolute;
          left:50%; top:45%;
          width:10px; height:10px;
          pointer-events:none;
          z-index:3;
        }
        .burst i{
          position:absolute;
          left:0; top:0;
          font-style:normal;
          font-size:22px;
          animation: burstOut var(--dur) cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) forwards;
        }
        @keyframes burstOut{
          0%{ transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0.2); opacity:0}
          15%{ opacity:1}
          100%{ transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--tx)), calc(-50% + var(--ty))) scale(1.2); opacity:0}
        }
        .big-love{
          position:absolute;
          left:50%; top:38%;
          transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
          z-index:5;
          pointer-events:none;
          text-align:center;
          width:100%;
        }
        .big-love span{
          font-family:"Dancing Script", cursive;
          font-size:54px;
          font-weight:700;
          background: linear-gradient(135deg,#d90429 0%,#ff8fab 100%);
          -webkit-background-clip:text;
          -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
          background-clip:text;
          -webkit-text-stroke: 3px white;
          paint-order: stroke fill;
          filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(201,24,74,0.28));
          display:inline-block;
          animation: bigLovePop 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) both, heartbeat 1.2s ease-in-out infinite 0.8s;
        }
        @keyframes bigLovePop{
          0%{ transform: scale(0.2); opacity:0}
          100%{ transform: scale(1); opacity:1}
        }
        @keyframes heartbeat{
          0%,100%{ transform: scale(1)}
          20%{ transform: scale(1.08)}
          40%{ transform: scale(0.98)}
          60%{ transform: scale(1.06)}
        }
        .kiss-btn-wrap{
          position:absolute;
          left:50%; bottom:8%;
          transform:translateX(-50%);
          z-index:6;
          animation: fadeIn 0.6s ease 0.6s both;
        }

        /* Kiss popup */
        .popup-overlay{
          position:fixed;
          inset:0;
          background: rgba(255,240,245,0.72);
          backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
          -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
          z-index:100;
          display:flex;
          align-items:center;
          justify-content:center;
          padding:16px;
          animation: popupIn 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) both;
          overflow-y:auto;
        }
        @keyframes popupIn{
          from{ opacity:0; transform:scale(0.92)}
          to{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1)}
        }
        .popup-card{
          width:100%;
          max-width:380px;
          background:#fff;
          border-radius:32px;
          box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(201,24,74,0.18), 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9) inset;
          padding:28px 22px 22px;
          text-align:center;
          position:relative;
          overflow:hidden;
        }
        .popup-card::before{
          content:"";
          position:absolute;
          top:0; left:0; right:0;
          height:120px;
          background: radial-gradient(90% 100% at 50% 0%, rgba(255,143,171,0.28) 0%, transparent 70%);
          pointer-events:none;
        }
        .popup-card.gallery-mode{
          max-width:640px;
          max-height:92vh;
          overflow-y:auto;
          padding-bottom:28px;
        }
        .heart-big{
          font-size:84px;
          display:inline-block;
          animation: heartbeat 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
          filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(201,24,74,0.22));
        }

        /* Gallery */
        .gallery-title{
          font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;
          font-size:22px;
          font-weight:700;
          color:#5a1a2a;
          line-height:1.25;
          margin:12px 0 8px;
        }
        .gallery-sub{
          font-size:13px;
          line-height:1.6;
          color:#8a5a66;
          margin-bottom:18px;
        }
        .polaroid{
          background:white;
          border-radius:16px;
          padding:10px 10px 28px;
          box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.04) inset;
          transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), box-shadow 0.28s;
          cursor:pointer;
          position:relative;
        }
        .polaroid:hover{ transform: scale(1.03) !important; box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)}
        .polaroid img{
          width:100%;
          aspect-ratio:4/5;
          object-fit:cover;
          border-radius:10px;
          display:block;
        }
        .polaroid .cap{
          position:absolute;
          bottom:4px;
          left:0; right:0;
          text-align:center;
          font-family:"Dancing Script",cursive;
          font-size:15px;
          color:#7a3442;
        }
        .polaroid.featured{
          padding:10px 10px 36px;
          transform: rotate(-2deg);
        }
        .polaroid.featured img{ aspect-ratio:4/5}
        .bow-badge{
          position:absolute;
          top:-10px; right:16px;
          width:36px; height:28px;
          background: linear-gradient(135deg,#d90429,#ff4d6d);
          clip-path: polygon(50% 0,100% 25%,100% 75%,50% 100%,0 75%,0 25%);
          display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
          color:white; font-size:14px;
          transform: rotate(12deg);
          box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(201,24,74,0.3);
        }
        .grid2{
          display:grid;
          grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
          gap:12px;
          margin-top:14px;
        }
        @media(max-width:520px){
          .grid2{ gap:10px}
          .title-main{font-size:34px}
        }
        .footer-date{
          margin-top:18px;
          text-transform:uppercase;
          font-size:11px;
          letter-spacing:0.12em;
          color:#b07a85;
          font-weight:600;
        }
        .confetti-heart{
          position:absolute;
          pointer-events:none;
          animation: confettiFall linear forwards;
        }
        @keyframes confettiFall{
          0%{ transform: translateY(-20px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); opacity:0}
          10%{opacity:1}
          100%{ transform: translateY(110vh) rotate(720deg) scale(1.2); opacity:0}
        }
        .final-hearts{
          position:fixed;
          inset:0;
          z-index:200;
          pointer-events:none;
          overflow:hidden;
        }
        .final-hearts i{
          position:absolute;
          left:var(--x);
          top:110%;
          font-size: var(--s);
          animation: finalUp var(--d) ease-out forwards;
        }
        @keyframes finalUp{
          0%{ transform: translateY(0) scale(0.5) rotate(0deg); opacity:0}
          10%{opacity:1}
          100%{ transform: translateY(-120vh) scale(1.4) rotate(20deg); opacity:0}
        }
        .lightbox{
          position:fixed;
          inset:0;
          background: rgba(0,0,0,0.82);
          z-index:300;
          display:flex;
          align-items:center;
          justify-content:center;
          padding:18px;
          backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }
        .lightbox img{
          max-width:92vw;
          max-height:86vh;
          border-radius:16px;
          box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
          animation: popupIn 0.35s ease;
        }
